status: normative terminal-design ontology; implementation maturity remains explicit per entity

meta.title: ETHOS continuable-reality ontology
meta.thesis: Keep the conditions by which shared software reality can be understood, challenged, changed, and continued independent of any transient actor, session, tool, or platform.
meta.product_definition: repository-native proof-carrying compiler and exact-CAS transaction protocol for repository change
meta.product_position: minimal constitutional narrow waist for autonomous, agentic-native repositories
meta.method: capability may compound; authority, evidence, and accepted reality remain distinct

maturity.canonical: stated by the current canonical product contract
maturity.current: directly supported by current repository docs, schemas, or code at the bound HEAD
maturity.terminal: desired terminal design; not necessarily delivered
maturity.optional: separately selected adapter or trust domain

product_contract.authority: canonical product meaning and semantic kernel

runner_mutation.authority: current runner, Work Lane, closeout, verifier and peer mutation boundaries

commitment_contract.authority: current immutable predecessor-set, fork/join and lineage/dependency semantics

lineage_governance.authority: current exact-tree predecessor resolution and scoped concurrency semantics

lineage_command.authority: current public predecessor selection and canonical request semantics

evolution_campaign.authority: current hypothesis, experiment, learning and successor-Commitment semantics

authorized_subject.label: Authorized subject
authorized_subject.semantics: Selects bounded intent under applicable external authority; authority is not inferred from execution or evidence.

authority_reference.label: Applicable authority
authority_reference.semantics: External authority binding for principal, subject, scope and validity.

commitment_n.label: Commitment n
commitment_n.semantics: Immutable intent, subject, scope, invariants, acceptance and authority reference.

fresh_facts.label: Fresh observations
fresh_facts.semantics: Context-bound observations over exact repository and dependency bindings; never durable authority.

prior_attestations.label: Applicable prior attestations
prior_attestations.semantics: Selected verifier-bound statements whose exact predicates, bindings and validity apply.

compile_plan.label: Compile bounded transition
compile_plan.semantics: Deterministic compilation from explicit Commitment, Facts, applicable Attestations and policy.

transition_plan.label: TransitionPlan
transition_plan.semantics: Transient exact-input-bound IR; never a workflow or progress store.

action_evaluation.label: Action admission
action_evaluation.semantics: Determines whether bounded candidate execution may proceed; does not by itself admit shared-reality effect.

skills.label: Skills
skills.semantics: Route actors to owner-native procedures and gates; own no plan, authority, progress or lifecycle state.

owner_native_tools.label: Owner-native tools
owner_native_tools.semantics: OpenSpec, Git, tests, docs, CI and provider tools retain their own semantics.

actor.label: Replaceable actor
actor.semantics: Human or agent identity admitted to execute; does not own repository truth merely by acting.

executor_loss.label: Actor / session / host loss
executor_loss.semantics: Interruption of execution without erasing durable roots or version reality.

work_lane.label: Work Lane generation
work_lane.semantics: One admitted, bounded candidate reality in one linked worktree, bound to one immutable base Commitment digest.

linked_worktree.label: Linked worktree
linked_worktree.semantics: Isolated preparation domain; mutation here is not yet accepted shared reality.

lease.label: Lease
lease.semantics: Holder, generation, expiry and exact binding; coordinates access but grants no semantic authority.

git_common_state.label: Git-common coordination
git_common_state.semantics: Shared Lease, transaction, receipt and runtime projection below one Git common directory; it coordinates a repository family but owns no semantic truth.

git_common_activation.label: Single Git-common activation
git_common_activation.semantics: Repository-common configuration selects one effective hook/runtime activation for the Git common directory; linked worktrees inherit it and cannot become parallel activation owners.

runtime_generation_retirement.label: Consumer-proved runtime retirement
runtime_generation_retirement.semantics: A generated hook/runtime generation may be retired only after every declared consumer surface proves that no consumer remains; unreadable observation fails closed.

repository_family_convergence.label: Repository-family convergence report
repository_family_convergence.semantics: One hook-install operation reports the common hooks path, immutable runtime identity, every linked worktree checked or repaired, and exact retained or removed generations.

exact_base.label: Exact candidate base
exact_base.semantics: Current candidate ref, HEAD and tree from which admitted Work Lanes diverge.

candidate_bundle.label: Proven lane candidate
candidate_bundle.semantics: One lane result with exact Commitment, base, scope, Lease, prewrite and proof bindings; eligible for one serialized candidate-ref integration attempt.

candidate_state.label: Candidate train state n
candidate_state.semantics: The exact candidate-ref HEAD from which admitted Work Lanes diverge and against which a lane integration is freshly compared.

local_claim.label: Local executed claim
local_claim.semantics: Bounded claim from local executed proof; implies no other proof plane.

independent_verifier.label: Independent verifier
independent_verifier.semantics: Separate trust identity that re-executes or checks declared proof; no repository effect path.

independent_claim.label: Scoped independent receipt
independent_claim.semantics: One-shot exact-bound receipt; mints no authority and does not authorize mutation in another repository.

composite_verifier.label: Responsible composite verifier
composite_verifier.semantics: Applies an explicit inference rule to named input claim identities; never amplifies authority or scope.

composite_claim.label: Bounded composite claim
composite_claim.semantics: New claim with explicit rule, responsible verifier, provenance and bounded scope.

effect_evaluation.label: Effect admission
effect_evaluation.semantics: Evaluates required returned evidence, exact authority, scope and current bindings before shared effect.

effect_recheck.label: Fresh effect-time recheck
effect_recheck.semantics: Re-observes authority, repository identity, expected state, scope and exact bindings immediately before effect.

admitted_runner.label: Admitted runner
admitted_runner.semantics: Current ETHOS command-plane implementation admitted to apply the already-authorized exact effect; it owns neither authority nor proof and cannot bypass the fresh recheck.

repo_cas.label: Exact Git CAS
repo_cas.semantics: Unique linearization point for the ETHOS self-governance repository shown in magnified section; the same local transaction law applies to every adopter boundary.

post_observation.label: Fresh post-observation
post_observation.semantics: Re-observes the exact reality boundary after the attempted effect.

outcome_unknown.label: Outcome unknown
outcome_unknown.semantics: CAS intent or receipt exists but fresh post-observation cannot bind the attempted effect to the current state; replay is forbidden until re-observe.

attestation_n.label: Scoped attestation n
attestation_n.semantics: Persistent verifier-bound statement of what was observed, decided, proved or effected; mints no authority.

authorized_selection.label: Authorized selection
authorized_selection.semantics: A newly authorized subject selects predecessor and applicable Attestation identities; permission is reacquired, never inherited.

recovery_anchor.label: Recovery anchor
recovery_anchor.semantics: Durable roots and reachable Git state from which a successor can freshly reconstruct; no privileged jump to effect.

successor_actor.label: Successor actor
successor_actor.semantics: New actor that must freshly observe, compile and reacquire applicable authority.

model_promotion.label: Promote smallest model boundary
model_promotion.semantics: Preserve conflict, promote the smallest model, recompile, verify and absorb or retire residue; no shim or parallel truth.

brownfield_repo.label: Brownfield repository
brownfield_repo.semantics: Inventory, preserve, expose conflicts, review binding, then use the same kernel without cloning repository semantics.

greenfield_repo.label: Greenfield repository
greenfield_repo.semantics: Declaration-first binding, minimal owner-native scaffold and first bounded Commitment; not a monolithic ETHOS template.

ethos_repo.label: ETHOS product repository
ethos_repo.semantics: Self-governance and model evolution cross the same kernel and effect aperture; no legislator bypass.

openspec_carrier.label: OpenSpec intent carrier
openspec_carrier.semantics: Current verified Change/design/spec/task/archive carrier for mutation-capable use; shapes no kernel ontology.

git_substrate.label: Git version substrate
git_substrate.semantics: Current versioned state and exact-CAS substrate; not ETHOS itself.

protocol_grammar.label: Exchangeable protocol grammar
protocol_grammar.semantics: Portable schema for expressing equivalent relations, bindings and verdicts; it grants no authority and owns no truth.

brownfield_conformance.label: Brownfield local conformance
brownfield_conformance.semantics: Repository-local judgment over imported protocol grammar and fresh local facts; neither grammar nor remote claims decide local truth.

greenfield_conformance.label: Greenfield local conformance
greenfield_conformance.semantics: Repository-local judgment over imported protocol grammar and fresh local facts; neither grammar nor remote claims decide local truth.

ethos_conformance.label: ETHOS local conformance
ethos_conformance.semantics: Repository-local judgment over imported protocol grammar and fresh local facts; neither grammar nor remote claims decide local truth.

predecessor_set.label: Canonical predecessor set
predecessor_set.semantics: Immutable backward Commitment identities resolved in the exact selected Git tree before effects.

change_lineage.label: Commitment partial order
change_lineage.semantics: Immutable backward-linked fork/join partial order derived from Commitment carriers; it is neither execution dependencies nor global serialization, and owns no mutable successor index.

scoped_concurrency.label: Scoped concurrency
scoped_concurrency.semantics: Disjoint scopes and effects may proceed concurrently; only conflicting exact Git or authority boundaries serialize.

scope_effect_binding.label: Scope / effect binding
scope_effect_binding.semantics: Exact declared paths, resource scopes, and effects used to admit concurrency and reject overlap before a tracked write.

prewrite_admission.label: Prewrite admission
prewrite_admission.semantics: Fresh path, repository-root, Lease-generation, holder, worktree, and expected-HEAD gate before tracked mutation.

lane_proof_claim.label: Lane-bound proof claim
lane_proof_claim.semantics: Executed proof bound to the Lane result HEAD and Commitment; it cannot authorize another Lane or repository.

selection_hold.label: Hold
selection_hold.semantics: Authorized selection may preserve an unresolved obligation without minting a successor Commitment.

selection_done.label: Done
selection_done.semantics: Authorized selection may close the bounded obligation when the evidence supports no successor.

owner_native_artifacts.label: Owner-native source / tests / config / docs
owner_native_artifacts.semantics: Repository-owned semantic sources and verification assets retain their native owners; ETHOS binds rather than clones them.

durable_evidence.label: Durable evidence
durable_evidence.semantics: Content-addressed evidence and receipts remain inspectable after transient execution disappears.

rebuildable_outputs.label: Rebuildable projections / generated outputs
rebuildable_outputs.semantics: Derived views may be regenerated from authoritative roots and must not become a parallel truth store.

brownfield_expected_state.label: Inherited exact state
brownfield_expected_state.semantics: Fresh inventory of existing history and repository-owned facts, preserving unrelated state and exposing conflicts before adoption effects.

greenfield_expected_state.label: Founding exact state
greenfield_expected_state.semantics: Founding authority, domain seed, expected absence, and minimal owner-native scaffold from which Accepted zero may be created.

brownfield_effect_recheck.label: Fresh adopter recheck
brownfield_effect_recheck.semantics: Boundary-local re-observation of authority, repository identity, expected inherited state, scope and bindings immediately before the brownfield effect.

brownfield_admitted_runner.label: Single-use admitted runner
brownfield_admitted_runner.semantics: A boundary-bound single-use executor admitted only by the brownfield fresh recheck; it owns neither authority nor proof.

brownfield_post_observation.label: Fresh adopter post-observation
brownfield_post_observation.semantics: Boundary-local observation of the exact brownfield ref after the attempted effect.

brownfield_effect_attestation.label: Scoped adopter attestation
brownfield_effect_attestation.semantics: Durable verifier-bound statement of the brownfield effect outcome; it carries evidence but mints no authority.

greenfield_effect_recheck.label: Fresh founding recheck
greenfield_effect_recheck.semantics: Boundary-local re-observation of founding authority, expected absence, scaffold scope and exact bindings immediately before creation.

greenfield_admitted_runner.label: Single-use admitted runner
greenfield_admitted_runner.semantics: A boundary-bound single-use executor admitted only by the greenfield fresh recheck; it owns neither authority nor proof.

greenfield_post_observation.label: Fresh founding post-observation
greenfield_post_observation.semantics: Boundary-local observation of the founding ref and scaffold after the attempted effect.

greenfield_effect_attestation.label: Scoped founding attestation
greenfield_effect_attestation.semantics: Durable verifier-bound statement of the greenfield effect outcome; it carries evidence but mints no authority.

publication_remote.label: Declared publication remote
publication_remote.semantics: An explicitly selected remote Git ref target with provider-local exact CAS; it is not an ETHOS adopter, repository truth owner, or cross-provider atomic participant.

publication_remote_observation.label: Remote ref observation
publication_remote_observation.semantics: Fresh provider observation of the selected target ref, request binding, and signature trust; not adopter conformance.

publication_effect_recheck.label: Fresh publication recheck
publication_effect_recheck.semantics: Boundary-local re-observation of the selected full remote ref, request digest and trust bindings immediately before publication.

publication_admitted_runner.label: Single-use publication runner
publication_admitted_runner.semantics: A target-bound single-use executor admitted only by the publication fresh recheck; it owns neither authority nor remote truth.

publication_post_observation.label: Fresh publication post-observation
publication_post_observation.semantics: Boundary-local provider observation of every selected remote ref after the attempted publication effect.

publication_effect_attestation.label: Scoped publication attestation
publication_effect_attestation.semantics: Durable verifier-bound statement of the peer-local publication outcome; it neither transfers nor invents authority.

adopter_peer_repo.label: Autonomous adopter repository
adopter_peer_repo.semantics: An independently governed adopter with its own authority, facts, conformance judgment, accepted Git reality and local effect aperture.

adopter_peer_conformance.label: Adopter peer local judgment
adopter_peer_conformance.semantics: Repository-local judgment over imported protocol grammar and fresh local facts; no remote claim decides local truth.

adopter_peer_expected_state.label: Peer exact state
adopter_peer_expected_state.semantics: Fresh local observation of the autonomous adopter peer repository before effect admission.

adopter_peer_effect_recheck.label: Fresh peer recheck
adopter_peer_effect_recheck.semantics: Boundary-local re-observation of authority, exact state, scope and bindings immediately before the adopter peer effect.

adopter_peer_admitted_runner.label: Single-use admitted runner
adopter_peer_admitted_runner.semantics: A boundary-bound single-use executor admitted only by the autonomous peer fresh recheck; it owns neither authority nor proof.

adopter_peer_post_observation.label: Fresh peer post-observation
adopter_peer_post_observation.semantics: Boundary-local observation of the autonomous peer ref after the attempted effect.

adopter_peer_effect_attestation.label: Scoped peer attestation
adopter_peer_effect_attestation.semantics: Durable verifier-bound statement of the autonomous peer effect outcome; it carries evidence but mints no authority.

candidate_integration_evaluation.label: Candidate integration admission
candidate_integration_evaluation.semantics: Selects at most one proved, nonconflicting Work Lane for the next candidate-ref attempt; it owns no queue, priority, or reusable permission.

candidate_effect_recheck.label: Fresh candidate-head recheck
candidate_effect_recheck.semantics: Re-observes the candidate ref, selected lane HEAD, ancestry, scope, Lease and proof immediately before integration.

candidate_admitted_runner.label: Candidate admitted runner
candidate_admitted_runner.semantics: Single-use command-plane execution admitted to advance only the candidate ref from the freshly observed expected HEAD.

candidate_cas.label: Exact candidate-ref CAS
candidate_cas.semantics: Linearizes one proved Work Lane into the local candidate train; concurrent preparation remains parallel, while ref advancement is one-at-a-time.

candidate_next.label: Candidate train state n+1
candidate_next.semantics: The newly observed candidate-ref HEAD after one successful lane integration; it becomes the exact base for later integrations and the proof target for accepted closeout.

candidate_post_observation.label: Candidate post-observation
candidate_post_observation.semantics: Re-observes the candidate ref after the CAS attempt and binds the observed result to the attempted lane integration.

candidate_effect_attestation.label: Candidate effect attestation
candidate_effect_attestation.semantics: Durable evidence of the candidate-ref effect and its post-state; it carries proof without transferring authority.

candidate_base_stale.label: Stale lane base
candidate_base_stale.semantics: A remaining Work Lane whose expected candidate base no longer equals the advanced candidate HEAD; it must refresh its base and re-prove before another integration attempt.

lane_relation_judgment.label: Lane relation judgment
lane_relation_judgment.semantics: Fresh scope/effect and hypothesis relations classify concurrent lanes as cooperative, comparative, dependent, or conflicting; no lane gains static priority.

lane_experiment_protocol.label: Experiment protocol
lane_experiment_protocol.semantics: Commitment-bound hypotheses, falsifiers, comparison method, and stopping rule for alternative lanes; it is not a lifecycle authority.

lane_comparative_claim.label: Comparative evidence claim
lane_comparative_claim.semantics: Exact-bound evidence compares alternative lane outcomes against the Commitment experiment protocol; evidence informs selection but grants no authority.

lane_disposition.label: Authorized lane disposition
lane_disposition.semantics: Fresh authorized judgment may admit, continue through refresh and re-proof, hold uncertainty, or retire a superseded lane after absorption and retirement proof.

lane_retirement.label: Evidence-bound lane retirement
lane_retirement.semantics: A landed or superseded Lane may be retired only by its explicit exact-HEAD lifecycle transaction; non-selection alone never deletes it.

invariants.statement: Every edge has a valid typed endpoint and unique identity.
Commitment and Attestation are the only durable semantic root concepts.
Every current claim carries current evidence references bound to the basis HEAD.
PASS, BLOCK and UNKNOWN are explicit at action admission; only PASS reaches execution.
Shared effect occurs only after evidence return, effect evaluation, PASS and fresh effect-time recheck.
BLOCK, UNKNOWN, contradiction, model gap, recovery and outcome-unknown have no effect bypass.
Capability, execution, proof, coordination, projection, carrier and conformance nodes cannot authorize effects.
Every effect aperture has a complete local pre-state, recheck, conditional effect, post-observation and Attestation chain.
Each governed reality boundary has exactly one local effect aperture; there is no global CAS.
Independent verifier has no effect path; its only product is an exact scoped claim.
Proof planes neither imply nor replace one another; composite claims require an explicit responsible verifier and rule.
Recovery and outcome-unknown re-enter through fresh observation and recompilation before any effect.
An Attestation never automatically creates a successor Commitment; authorized selection reacquires authority.
Actor, session or host loss does not break Commitment, Attestation or version lineages.
Each Work Lane generation binds exactly one base Commitment digest and exact candidate base.
Worktree, Lease and git-common runtime coordinate candidate preparation and own no truth or authority.
Brownfield, Greenfield, self-governance, and autonomous adopter peers keep local authority and judgment; publication remotes remain distinct projection targets.
Cross-repository exchange is limited to scoped claims, artifacts and conformance; authority is never exchanged.
Projections are outward-only and may not reverse-own their source or hide required gaps.
OpenSpec and Git realize the selected terminal design but are carriers, not ETHOS semantic roots.
Commitment predecessors form an immutable partial order: fork and join are allowed, lineage is distinct from execution dependencies, and only conflicting scoped effects serialize.
The effect gate, PASS verdict, fresh recheck, and admitted runner each dominate the primary effect aperture in the control/effect subgraph.
Each local aperture has a closed effect-capable ingress set containing only its contract-bound admitted runner edge.
Action and effect gates are conjunctive over their declared inputs and exact scoped-claim selector; removing a required input blocks admission.
Every autonomous repository and publication target has one complete boundary-local effect contract and one unique linearization point; no contract crosses a boundary.
Brownfield, Greenfield, self-governance, autonomous peer, and publication remote retain distinct origin, authority, judgment, and effect semantics.
Responsibility and accepted-reality lineages outlive actor, session, host, tool, and platform loss without transferring authority.
Concurrent candidate preparation preserves a complete Commitment, plan, Lane, exact base, Lease, scope/effect, prewrite, and proof tuple per generation.

Concurrent Work Lanes prepare and prove independently, but candidate-ref integration and accepted-root closeout are distinct exact-CAS linearization boundaries; after candidate advancement, any stale remaining Lane refreshes and re-proves before a later attempt.

Work Lanes support both cooperative parallelism and comparative racing; integration, refresh, hold, and superseded retirement are relation-aware dispositions, and non-selection never implies automatic deletion.

action_admission_gate.required_claim_selector: all applicable scoped prior Attestations selected by the Commitment

effect_admission_gate.required_claim_selector: all declared proof-plane claims whose exact subject, predicate, scope, bindings, validity and verifier apply

publication_admission_gate.required_claim_selector: one selected full ref, request digest, repository common directory, signature trust and every target ref

candidate_integration_gate.required_claim_selector: the one selected Lane claim whose exact Commitment, candidate base, scope, Lease, HEAD and proof apply

ethos_effect.resource_scope: accepted-root Git ref and declared closeout scope

brownfield_effect.resource_scope: one adopter-local governed ref and declared effect scope

greenfield_effect.resource_scope: one adopter-local founding ref and declared scaffold scope

publication_effect.resource_scope: one explicitly selected full remote ref

adopter_peer_effect.resource_scope: one adopter-local governed ref and declared effect scope

candidate_integration_effect.resource_scope: candidate Git ref and one selected proved Work Lane

responsibility.ordering: immutable Commitment predecessor partial order with fork/join; scoped Attestations inform explicit reauthorization but never inherit permission

accepted_reality.ordering: per-repository exact-CAS linearization from accepted state to accepted state with an open future

cooperative.meaning: Different bounded directions may progress concurrently; multiple proved results may enter the candidate train over successive exact-CAS advances.

comparative.meaning: Racing lanes generate comparable evidence; an authorized judgment may select at most one result for a candidate attempt.

lane_modes.law: Concurrency prepares possibilities; relation-aware evidence and authority determine disposition. Non-selection is not failure, refresh, or deletion.
